==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

[[Perrin Aybara]] and a large group of [[Two Rivers]] men, ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'', [[Wise One]]s, and [[Faile Bashere]] and [[Berelain sur Paendrag Paeron]] reach the spot mentioned by the scouts. The meadow to the side of the [[Jehannah Road]] had taken the appearance of the [[Blight]]: spotted, and smelling of rot. In the center of the meadow was a village of curiously-made huts, all deserted. They determine that the village had been transported there from the Blight and Perrin orders that it all be burnt with the [[One Power]] to try and keep it from spreading.

Later, Perrin finds himself in the [[Dreaming|wolf dream]], after having fallen asleep reading a copy of the ''[[The Travels of Jain Farstrider|Travels of Jain Farstrider]]''. The wolf inside him was being called to form a pack and fight against a gathering storm. [[Hopper]] appeared, and attempted to teach Perrin how to use the wolf dream. He saw some visions: [[Matrim Cauthon]] fighting against several visions of himself and not seeing a shadowy figure with a bloody knife sneaking behind him; sheep in a flock with wolves (who looked wrong) chasing them towards a terrible beast; [[Faile Bashere|Faile]], [[Jur Grady|Grady]], [[Gaul]], and [[Elyas Machera]] walking towards a cliff, followed by thousands of others.

Hopper returns and shows Perrin an image of how he looked while he was hunting for Faile; an image bearing striking similarities to [[Noam]]. Perrin finally remembers how to quick-move while [[Dreamwalking]] and catches up to the pack to run with them a while. Despite fearing losing himself to the wolves, he caught the scent of a white stag and became a wolf, [[Young Bull]], in the dream. He caught the stag and was about to kill, but Hopper stopped him since this would cause it to die the last death. Hopper will teach Perrin of the wolf dream, and though he believes it would push him close to becoming lost in the wolf, Perrin agrees. He had avoided it for too long.

:{{pov|[[Galadedrid Damodred]]}}

[[Galadedrid Damodred]] had his fewer-than-20,000 [[Children of the Light|Children]] pitching camp on their way to [[Andor]] some way west of the great highways to keep them away from the movements of opposing forces. He has ordered [[Hand of the Light|Questioners]] to camp interspersed with the other [[Children of the Light]] in the hopes that doing so will promote comradery between the two groups. He was arguing with his [[Lord Captain|Lords Captain]] about sending a letter to the remaining Questioners and Children of the Light still under the control of the [[Seanchan]], letting them know what had happened and asking that they join him as soon as possible. Conversation quickly turned to Galad's plan to ally the Children with the [[Aes Sedai]] for the [[Last Battle]], and how the over-eagerness of the Children may have distanced them from allies.

[[Jaret Byar]] returned from watching the Jehannah Road, having zealously captured a strange group of dozens of travelers and their heavily-laden carts: Perrin's camp followers. [[Basel Gill]] heads the caravan and is questioned by Galad, formulating a clever story about merchants. Catching the scent of a lie, Galad separates the captives so they could be questioned independently and their stories compared. The questioning revealed the location and composition of Perrin's camp, much to [[Dain Bornhald|Child Bornhald's]] frenzied pleasure. Child Bornhald is delighted because Byar had reported that Perrin had killed his father,{{ref/book|3|p}} when in fact Dain Bornhald's father died in the charge expelling the [[Seanchan]] from [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|47}}
